config.title: Bouldering in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: What Berlin boulder halls cost, when a membership pays off, how the Berlin bouldert pass and Urban Sports Club work, and when climbing is cheapest.

items.q: How much does bouldering cost in Berlin?
items.a: An adult day ticket at the main Berlin boulder halls costs €12 to €14.50, checked on 18 September 2026. urban apes charges €13.90 (€14.90 in Friedrichshain), Der Kegel €11 and the small Ninja Bloc room in Köpenick €9. Magic Mountain, mainly a rope hall, charges €20. Shoe hire adds about €4 at most halls.

items.q: When is a bouldering membership in Berlin worth it?
items.a: At most halls a membership of €50 to €60 a month overtakes the 10-visit card around the fifth visit a month. At Boulderklub Kreuzberg the €54 membership equals four day tickets, and at Der Kegel the €59 month card wins from the sixth visit. Ostbloc and Südbloc reach €50 and €52 only on 12-month contracts.

items.q: What is the Berlin bouldert pass?
items.a: Berlin bouldert is a joint app pass from six independent halls: Bouldergarten, Boulderklub Kreuzberg, Elektra, Der Kegel, Ostbloc and Südbloc. The large pass costs €59 a month with unlimited entries, the small pass €39 for four entries across the six halls, both with one month notice.

items.q: Can I go bouldering in Berlin with Urban Sports Club?
items.a: Yes, but not on the Essential plan, which does not open the boulder halls. Classic (€75 a month) works at most halls with a cap of 8 visits a month, daily at Der Kegel, Ostbloc and Südbloc, and 4 visits at Berta Block. Magic Mountain was not open to private plans and Cliffhanger was not on the list.

items.q: When is bouldering cheapest in Berlin?
items.a: On weekday mornings. Most halls sell an off-peak ticket before 14:00, 15:00 or 16:00 on weekdays that are not public holidays: €8 at Südbloc, €9 at Der Kegel and Ostbloc, €11 at Boulderklub Kreuzberg and €11.90 at urban apes. Elektra also sells a weekday-morning membership for €42.

items.q: Can I use an urban apes 10-visit card at another urban apes hall?
items.a: No. The urban apes 10+1 card is tied to the person and to the hall where it was bought. To climb in every urban apes hall you need the L membership at €69.90 a month plus a €19.90 joining fee.
